messages:
deploybot: Initiating prod deploy (eu-west-1) — non-disruptive rollforward. Release tag: prod-2026-03-20-1. Canary strategy 10/50/100.
deploybot: Commits referenced in this deploy (author / PR / commit link):
- 9f3b2a1 (alice) PR #1423 https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1423 commit https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/9f3b2a1
- b2a7c3d (bob) PR #1419 https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1419 commit https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/commit/b2a7c3d
- c0ffee00 (carla) PR #1430 https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1430 commit https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/commit/c0ffee00
- d4e5f6a (dave) PR #1405 https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge/pull/1405 commit https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge/commit/d4e5f6a

alice: quick heads-up — runtime change touches KV cache eviction threshold. smoke test plan: run sample workload for 5m on canary.
bob: noted. I'll watch latency dashboards. tagging the canary dash: https://console.redwood/instrumentation/dash/kv-eviction
carla: console change is UI-only but added a new feature flag. should be safe.
release-manager: keeping the window open for 2h. if something odd -> manual rollback.
deploybot: Canary 10% -> OK. 50% -> rolling.
carla: observed a JS console error in canary 50% for /settings, stack points to PR #1430. Error: TypeError undefined is not a function.
dave: reproducing locally now. if it's benign we can hotfix, else we should pin console to prod-2026-03-03 for country-ui service.
bob: latency increased ~120ms at 50% on serving instance type g5. Looking at traces, kernel selection path changed with runtime commit 9f3b2a1.
alice: 9f3b2a1 was intended to lower eviction; maybe working set thrashing. we can rollback runtime change to 9f3b2a1~ (previous SHA: a1b2c3d) or pin serving to previous tag? what's cheaper?
dave: console JS error looks like a race with new feature flag; quick patch won't be safe for prod in window. recommend pinning console to previous tag and continuing other commits.
release-manager: decision call: pin console -> revert commit c0ffee00 from this rollout and proceed with runtime/serving/edge. Can someone confirm pin and update rollout plan? @deploybot schedule change? :white_check_mark:
carla: ack — creating rollback pin for console service to tag prod-2026-03-03. PR to infra pinned version: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-config/pull/1107 (pin console -> prod-2026-03-03)
deploybot: Applying pin: removed c0ffee00 from current deploy set. Updated rollout: 9f3b2a1, b2a7c3d, d4e5f6a. New canary run starting.
dave: starting manual smoke (runtime + serving + edge) — will run standard runbook.
bob: monitoring traces, serving p95 returned to baseline after kernel selector tweak revert in config (hotpatch applied to serving nodes).
alice: confirmed runtime change 9f3b2a1 is backported config tweak to avoid eviction thrash, validated on canary.
deploybot: Canary 10% OK. 50% OK. 100% roll complete for runtime/serving/edge. Console pinned to previous tag (prod-2026-03-03).
release-manager: rolling notes: console pinned due to UI regression (PR #1430). runtime and serving shipped; edge shipped. Will include rationale in release notes.
deploybot: Deploy finished at 1950000299. Final applied commits: 9f3b2a1, b2a7c3d, d4e5f6a. Skipped/Pin: c0ffee00 (console) -> pinned to prod-2026-03-03 via deploy-config PR #1107.
deploybot: Release artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/release/prod-2026-03-20-1. Rollout summary + commit links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/prod-2026-03-20-1
release-manager: I'll draft release notes and include the pin + follow-up tasks (console bugfix + small runtime perf regression audit). assigning follow-ups: @carla fix console PR #1430 (backfill tests) ; @alice perf audit for 9f3b2a1; @dave QA verification for pinned console tag.
carla: noted, will open follow-up PR for UI fix and add e2e for /settings.
dave: QA will validate tomorrow morning in staging then greenlight patch for console.
bob: adding monitoring anomaly alert for kernel-selection p95 deviation.
release-manager: closing deploy thread. thanks everyone. :tada:
